summary: EfficientNet-B5 Phase 2 (frozen phase1 heads) on crops dataset. lr=1e-4, backbone-lr-scale=0.1, wd=0.01, bs=12, grad-accum-steps=2, 30 epochs. Loaded phase1 checkpoint. Phase1 heads frozen for all epochs. Best overall accuracy 75.87% at epoch 3. New tasks (arch_style, building_form) converged quickly but plateaued at lower accuracy than hoped. Phase1 tasks regressed despite frozen heads, confirming backbone drift is the limiting factor.

comparison.vs_b5_crop_v2_phase2: +0.34pp overall (75.87% vs 75.51%). Freezing phase1 heads did not prevent regression on phase1 tasks — backbone drift is the limiting factor.
comparison.vs_b5_full_v2_phase2: Crops: overall 75.87%, arch_style 71.98%. Full: overall 74.41%, arch_style 73.03%. Crops win on stories (+3.7pp) and cladding (+4.5pp), full images win on arch_style (+1.1pp).

learnings: Freezing phase1 heads does not prevent regression on phase1 tasks — the backbone is still being pulled by new heads.
New tasks (arch_style, building_form) plateau at 72%/65% — same as previous runs. The backbone is at capacity for this dataset.
Crops win on stories and cladding, full images win on arch_style. The tradeoff is real and persistent.
Further improvement likely requires more data or a multi-encoder architecture.
